messages.author: f957fda17cafa763
messages.subject: Reconnecting on ShinyApps.io
parts:
Hello,
Is there a plan to roll out reconnection by default to existing session (as in this article http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/reconnecting.html) to ShinyApps.io?
I work on OS X and therefore, as far as I understand it, cannot run Shiny Server or RS Connect.
regards, Andrew

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Reconnecting on ShinyApps.io
parts:
This is being tested on shinyapps.io, but we do not currently have a date for when it will be enabled by default.
I would expect that we will post to the list when it becomes available.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Reconnecting on ShinyApps.io
parts:
The reconnect feature would help if the client's network connection drops out briefly.

But if your app is experiencing the gray disconnect on shinyapps.io because it consumes too much memory, say, then a paid account and moving to a larger instance type could help.

If you are looking at RStudio's professional offerings to run on your own servers, you would need to speak with a team member about what education discount might arranged.
